final: WITH b AS (SELECT o.timespan AS ts, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT ts, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM b) AS share FROM b), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share_of_kept, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
